name: Linkage
brief: Move a 500 g load one metre across a table on stored energy alone. No motors, no batteries.

name: Sense
brief: Build an instrument that measures something you cannot see, and show that it agrees with a known reference.
measure: Agreement with the reference across the range

name: Helio
brief: Harvest power by day, store it, and run a load through the night. Report a real round-trip efficiency.

name: Span
brief: Cross a 400 mm gap carrying as much as you can. Then load it until it breaks and film the failure.
measure: Grams carried per gram of structure

name: Ray
brief: Form a readable image of a distant object, then tell us precisely what is limiting its sharpness.
measure: Resolved line pairs, and the honesty of the limit analysis

name: Cycle
brief: Keep a plant alive for six weeks inside a closed loop, logging every input you give it.
measure: Biomass gained per litre of water used
